definitions.explanation: Attached to a Sino-Japanese noun to name a stretch of land, a climatic region, or a range on a scale: {温帯|おんたい} (temperate zone), {火山帯|かざんたい} (volcanic belt), {時間帯|じかんたい} (time slot).

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温帯|おんたい}→温帯：04479_ontai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Most of Japan lies in the temperate zone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The trains are crowded during this time slot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{一年中|いちねんじゅう}{気温|きおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: On tropical islands the temperature is high all year round.

examples.japanese: {日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{火山帯|かざんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧や⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Because the Japanese archipelago sits on a volcanic belt, it has many earthquakes and eruptions.

notes:
From ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧ (sash, belt), read たい in compounds. The image is a long band — of land, of climate, or of values along a scale.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{温帯|おんたい}→温帯：04479_ontai⟧: temperate zone
- ⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧: tropics
- ⟦{寒帯|かんたい}→寒帯：04124_kantai⟧: frigid zone
- {火山帯|かざんたい}: volcanic belt
- ⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧: time slot, time band
- {価格帯|かかくたい}: price range

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{域|いき}: area, region — marks a bounded area rather than a band (⟦{流域|りゅういき}→流域：19664_ryuuiki⟧, river basin)
- 〜⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧: layer, stratum — a layer stacked with others, including social strata (⟦{年齢層|ねんれいそう}→年齢層：25966_nenreisou⟧, age group)
